interface.shortDescription: Design, debug, refactor, and deliver with bounded context.
interface.longDescription: Task-oriented Codex skills for complexity reduction, human-readable project control, root-cause debugging, disciplined delivery, safe refactoring, architecture decisions, and opt-in reasoning under tested context budgets.
defaultPrompt: Review this change for accidental complexity and contextual code smells.
Plan this refactor as small behavior-preserving steps with a risk-based test gate.
Audit the load-bearing assumptions and competing explanations behind this architecture decision.
Diagnose this failure from evidence, test competing hypotheses, and verify the root-cause correction.
Execute this substantial change with controlled checkpoints and fresh completion evidence.
Audit this repository for documentation drift and establish an evidence-backed human control plane.
